notes: All12 claim-to-accepted-completion intervals were actual current-agent gameplay service: live observations, ordinary resource decisions, cited knowledge, durable learning/replay, score evidence and status commentary where it occurred.
Claim timing includes reasoning, bridge/tool calls, scheduling and intervening progress/status commentary; it is not isolated inference time.
No source/report/capture/ledger-tool authoring, developer debugging or artificial thinking delay occurred during the fixed window. Prepared evidence ledgers wrote automatically.
Prepared observation waits were outside completed claims. Unclaimed observation/status/scheduling periods remain in the whole-run totals.

planningLatency.meaning: Current claims end after successful validation/commit or explicit null decline. Rejected submissions remain inside the open claim through correction. Claim time includes reasoning/tools/scheduling/status commentary, not isolated inference.
planningLatency.requestLifetimeMeaning: Automatic prefetch can precede a claim, including the preparation period before this measurement. Unclaimed request lifetime is not model thinking. Every actual claim-to-acceptance interval is included.

failureRate.denominator: Completed helper dispatch attempts = helper-verified completions + failed attempts; excludes passive effect steps and in-flight attempts.

failureCounting.note: Do not invent a category or successful outcome for a failed counter increment without routine_failed evidence. All failures remain in the completed-attempt rate.

episodeOutcomes.meaning: Only episode events captured within exact boundary, joined to private persisted action outcomes. No raw state/name/chat or private path is published.

comparison.timingConclusion: Visible-idle percentage and helper throughput are worse than the historical high-skill standing run. This distinct fresh-account session establishes continuing gameplay with bounded separate-process scoring, not causal no-slowdown or improved frontier-model speed.

jointAssessment.note: Lower idle alone does not establish success; inspect helper ambiguity, action rate, failures and actual progress. Skill/workload/network differences remain.
jointAssessment.scoringGatedActionsMeaning: No scoring await/approval in dispatch; process-delay/failure fixtures and live continuing work support this contract. They do not prove zero execution overhead or hidden idle.
